content: HLC edge cases: forward wall-clock jump makes the node emit future timestamps that win all LWW conflicts until real time catches up (poisoning propagates to peers via Update since l=max(l,pt,lmsg)); backward jump freezes l at the old high value while counter c inflates - timestamps look like (old_l, huge_c); l-pt divergence can grow unboundedly and must be alerted on (drift warning). HLC guarantees only partial order. CockroachDB bounds skew with max-offset (default 500ms) and self-terminates nodes exceeding it; uses uncertainty restarts instead of waiting. sup-kv design has drift_warn 60s but no bound on accepting future timestamps - documented operational risk, must be surfaced in metrics/docs.
